tools.name: search
tools.description: Return ids and titles of source cards whose keywords match the query; does not read their claim text.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Read one source by id returned from search. Returns source claims and original-paper attribution.

tools.name: write_brief
tools.description: Compose a fixed research-brief template using exactly three source cards already read. Writes only final-brief.md in the active run directory.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Check actual final file and recorded observations against the shared structural rubric. Does not evaluate arbitrary semantic entailment.
